source_metadata.title: Cirrhosis, Thrombosis, Finding FaXts about Doses: Dosing of Unfractionated Heparin for Venous Thromboembolism in Cirrhosis

extraction_limitations: The study supplement containing the full institutional UFH nomogram was referenced but was not embedded in the supplied PDF, so nomogram steps beyond those stated in the main text were not extracted.

The source labels the prespecified primary efficacy outcome as mean therapeutic UFH rate in Methods, while later Results prose refers to the statistically significant therapeutic-achievement comparison as the primary outcome; atoms preserve the reported outcome definition and results without silently reconciling this inconsistency.

No noncirrhotic control group was present in this study; statements comparing cirrhosis with noncirrhotic patients in the Discussion refer to prior literature and were not extracted as primary-study results.
All atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; no human verification was performed.
